login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password your administrator gave you.
login.help: Forgot your password? Ask your system administrator to reset it.
login.fieldError: Check the email and password, then try again.

invalid.title: Email or password is wrong.
invalid.body: Check both and try again. After 5 wrong tries, sign-in pauses for 15 minutes.

locked.title: Sign-in is paused for this email.
locked.body_one: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{count}} minute, or ask your administrator.
locked.body_other: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{count}} minutes, or ask your administrator.

offline.title: No connection to the server.
offline.body: Check the network, then try again. Nothing you typed is lost.

other.title: Something went wrong.
other.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

login.statementShort: Orders, machines, stock and shifts in one place.
login.statementLong: Orders, machines, stock and shifts in one place, from the receipt to the finished goods store.
